name: pnpm-lockfile-vs-overrides-gotcha
observations: When pnpm 10 has overrides in pnpm-workspace.yaml, the lockfile (pnpm-lock.yaml) is checked against those overrides by `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` in CI. If the lockfile was generated before the overrides were finalized (e.g., during a branch that pre-dates the overrides block), CI aborts with ERR_PNPM_LOCKFILE_CONFIG_MISMATCH. Fix: run `pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile` locally, commit the regenerated pnpm-lock.yaml alongside the change. Symptom in this repo appeared when rebasing chore/cleanups onto origin/main after the security PR's overrides were added.
